assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A polished original isometric illustration for a Japanese recruiting LINE service landing page. Crisp vector-like editorial illustration, axonometric 30-degree perspective, careful thin charcoal outlines, flat white and fresh lime and vivid green planes, small sunflower-yellow accents, tiny soft ground shadows. Human people have simple pleasant faces and correct proportions, white shirts, green or charcoal clothing. Confident professional B2B marketing illustration, thoughtfully arranged objects, not a clay toy render, not photorealistic, no blue/purple, no gradients in the artwork. Pure white background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no LINE icon, no watermark, no picture frame. Landscape 3:2 composition, isolated scene entirely visible with generous white margin, usable as a real website image. Main hero: a miniature recruiting world built around one large upright smartphone showing abstract green rectangular messaging cards and a small yellow check mark. The phone stands on a wide layered white isometric platform. On the left a compact Japanese factory with green roofs and two industrial workers in helmets; on the right a small bright office and an HR manager greeting a candidate, with another candidate walking toward the phone. A green path physically links the places. A couple of floating candidate profile cards and an abstract calendar create a sense of connection. Balanced dense central composition, six small people maximum, the phone is the focal point, strong graphic silhouette. No speech-bubble logo.
